Attachments to send: W-9/W-8, bank letter or voided check (bank docs), and any tax registration docs if relevant. If you prefer, you can upload directly to the secure folder I created and paste the link here.

If there's anything sensitive you don't want sent over email, tell us and we'll provide a secure upload link.
